name: standmeet-fetch-mcp
description: fetch block (JS, cross-platform — replaces the vendored Python mcp-server-fetch and its Linux-musl wheels): a stdio-MCP server whose fetch tool GETs a URL, converts HTML→markdown, and honors robots.txt. Owns no data; its only egress is the fetch itself (network posture is the manifest's, unchanged). As JS it cannot import host/Go internals — host-blindness is structural, and there is no more per-arch native dependency, so it runs on any runner.
